text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping with Bamboo 
Memory...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Trainer! This is the most hype 
situation ever to kick off the new year!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right! Don't they say that moments like 
this test your daily conduct?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In other words! This is a test to see if 
I'm properly setting a good example for 
everyone as the head of the Morals 
Committee, right!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And so! Here are the lottery tickets I got 
while shopping earlier! I'm betting 
everything on these!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, ever since I met you, Trainer, I've 
been giving it my all with the 
Disciplinary Committee and racing alike!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
With how I am right now, God will 
definitely gift me a great result, 
yes-sir!

"Bamboo Memory's eyes shone brightly. 
Hopefully this enthusiasm will be 
rewarded, but as for the outcome—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right!! Here I go, then, ssir~!!

And then, Bamboo Memory gave the lottery 
wheel a vigorous, full-powered spin!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ultra! High-Speed! Spin!!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: O-Oh... Oooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We did it-ssu! Trainer-san, look, look! 
It's the grand prize-ssu~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~! Taking things seriously really 
paid off~! Thank you, Lord!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, my imagination's running wild! I 
wonder if they have wooden swords as 
souvenirs...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—No! I can't let myself get carried away! 
Since we're going on a trip, I've gotta 
plan it properly so it'll be the absolute 
best memory!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I want you to hold onto this 
ticket for a while, please!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've worked hard up until now, but... I 
still don't feel like I've produced 
results worthy of a reward!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that I ran an awesome race with my 
rivals, giving it everything I got! That's 
my absolute requirement!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! That'll definitely make 
the hot springs the best memory ever, 
cap'n!
choice_data_list: If that's the case, I'll take care of it.
If that's the case, I'll hold onto it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'll work even harder 
so I can soak in those hot springs and hot 
memories!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... When that time comes, I 
definitely want you looking back on the 
memories with me, Trainer! Promise, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, please keep it safe for me! It's 
a promise on our souls~!

To make the upcoming trip the absolute 
best it could be, Bamboo Memory resolved 
once more to put her all into it.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Deluxe quality!! It's a 1st place 
prize, but it's deluxe... Isn't this 
basically the Grand Prize?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this looks deliciousss! It looks way 
too good to just enjoy all by myself!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Wanna eat together? Like eating 
tonkatsu to guarantee a win, I wanna eat 
this as a good luck charm for the race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, then let's head straight back 
to the academy and get ready in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for waiting! Here's your piping 
hot hamburg steak~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I came up with the perfect prayer 
words to make a wish, too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No" half-baked efforts! "Bur"st out with 
pride! "Ger"t your teeth and run straight 
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, if I do say so myself, this fits like 
a glove! What do you think, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well then... thanks for the food!!

A hamburger steak made with a wish to 
simply give it our all. Its flavor was 
truly worthy of a "Grand Prize"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Are you sure I can have this much, 
boss!? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a mountain of carrots that one person 
could never finish eating...! This must be 
*that*, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's an enthusiastic cheer from God 
saying, "Share it with your rival and 
build up your energy!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Strike while the iron is hot! Let's take 
this back to the academy right away and 
gather everyone up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—Here ya go, here ya go! It's my family's 
special stamina carrot meal! Eat up to 
your heart's content!”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... A whole platter full of carrot 
dishes... ...*drool*.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This certainly looks energizing. I 
appreciate it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—I shall partake of this to nurture the 
strength to run once more.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! "A carrot a day keeps failure away!"

To keep running with fiery passion... 
Bamboo Memory and her rivals rested and 
replenished their spirits.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Missing the grand prize is a bummer, 
but... that's one magnificent carrot!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm! Winning this must be a sign that I 
need to recharge my energy to the max, 
ssu!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"With something like this, taking a huge 
bite out of it is the best way to go! Time 
to dig i—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa-whoa, if I eat this here, it counts 
as eating on the go... no, eating a 
handout? Or a winning snack? Either way, 
not good!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Such an act is completely unbecoming of a 
Disciplinary Committee member! Here, we 
must—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll sprint back to the academy at full 
power! And then I'll happily dig in, sir!

And then, Bamboo Memory sprinted with all 
her might... and most gratefully accepted 
the carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aargh...! It's a dud! Man, this is so 
frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Hrrrm, but even this! Maybe it's a pack 
of tissues meant for 'wiping away your 
sweat after winning the race!'

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Or maybe these tissues are meant for 
wiping away the tears of regret from 
pulling a losing ticket~...?!

"...Bamboo Memory is always positive, but 
coming away completely empty-handed seemed 
to hurt just a little bit."
